lifeStages.name: Puppy (2 - 12 Months)
lifeStages.summary: Rapid developmental growth phase requiring high biological protein, bioavailable calcium-phosphorus ratio, and DHA omega-3s for brain and vision maturation.
lifeStages.hydrationRequirement: 60 - 100 ml per kg of body weight daily
proTips: Soak dry kibble in warm bone broth or botanical rosewater tea during teething weeks.
Maintain scheduled mealtimes and remove untouched food after 20 minutes to reinforce healthy digestive rhythm.
Never feed cooked bones, allium bulbs, or artificial sweeteners (xylitol/birch sugar).

lifeStages.name: Adult Dog (1 - 7 Years)
lifeStages.summary: Maintenance of lean muscle mass, joint cartilage elasticity, and sustained cellular energy with balanced whole-food proteins and botanical fiber.
lifeStages.hydrationRequirement: 50 - 60 ml per kg body weight daily
proTips: Rotate novel single-source proteins quarterly (Venison, Duck, Wild Salmon) to prevent dietary sensitivities.
Incorporate steamed pumpkin puree or fermented kefir for optimal prebiotic gut motility.
Adjust caloric intake downward by 10% during sedentary winter months.

lifeStages.name: Kitten (2 - 12 Months)
lifeStages.summary: Obligate carnivores in accelerated growth requiring dense animal-derived taurine, arginine, arachidonic acid, and high moisture to safeguard lifelong urinary tract health.
lifeStages.frequency: 4 to 5 small meals daily (or free-choice premium wet food)
lifeStages.hydrationRequirement: 70 - 80 ml per kg body weight daily (primarily via moisture-rich food)
proTips: Prioritize moisture-rich pâté over dry extruded kibble to prevent chronic subclinical dehydration.
Introduce ceramic circulating water fountains early to engage natural flowing-water hunting instincts.
Ensure essential amino acid Taurine is always guaranteed on dietary labels.

lifeStages.name: Adult Cat (1 - 10 Years)
lifeStages.summary: Strict carnivorous metabolic profile requiring pure animal proteins, controlled magnesium and phosphorus ratios, and hydration support for kidney preservation.
lifeStages.hydrationRequirement: 50 - 60 ml per kg body weight daily
proTips: Elevate food bowls by 10-15cm to align feline esophagus posture and curb post-meal regurgitation.
Keep the water bowl in a distinct room separated from food, honoring instinctive feline hygiene habits.
Avoid high carbohydrate fillers (wheat, corn, soy) to maintain ideal lean body condition.
